The 1945–46 season was [[List of Real Madrid CF seasons|Real Madrid Club de Fútbol's 43rd season]] in existence and the club's [[La Liga|14th consecutive season]] in the top flight of Spanish football.

==Summary==
Under the management of [[Jacinto Quincoces]],<ref>{{cite web |url=http://futbol.sportec.es/seleccion/ficha_jugador.asp?j=531&n=quincoces/i/jacinto/fernandez/de/quincoces/y/lopez/de/arbina |title= Fútbol en la Red|website=futbol.sportec.es |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20091222225147/http://futbol.sportec.es/seleccion/ficha_jugador.asp?j=531&n=quincoces%2Fi%2Fjacinto%2Ffernandez%2Fde%2Fquincoces%2Fy%2Flopez%2Fde%2Farbina |archive-date=22 December 2009}}</ref> the club finished on a decent 4th spot in the [[1945–46 La Liga|league]], five points below champions [[Sevilla FC|Sevilla CF]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://sevilla.abc.es/orgullodenervion/noticias-sevilla-fc/sevi-recuerdo-del-sevilla-al-equipo-campeon-liga-1946-201803311454_noticia.html|title=Memories of Sevilla 1946 Champion|work=ABC|location=Seville, Spain|date=31 March 2018|accessdate=30 November 2020|language=Spanish}}</ref> The squad also reached the [[1946 Copa del Generalísimo Final]] after defeating [[CD Alcoyano|Alcoyano]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.lavanguardia.com/deportes/futbol/20121031/54353691906/copa-del-rey-alcoyano-real-madrid-batalla-del-agua.html|title=The Battle of the Water|work=La Vanguardia|date=31 October 2012|accessdate=30 November 2020|language=Spanish}}</ref> and clinched its eighth cup title with a victory over [[Valencia CF]],<ref>{{cite web|url=https://as.com/futbol/2013/01/09/copa_del_rey/1357770829_300022.html|publisher=as.com|title=8–7 Real Madrid against Valencia|date=9 January 2013|accessdate=20 November 2020}}</ref> thanks to a [[Pruden]] brace and a goal from [[Sabino Barinaga]].<ref>{{usurped|1=[https://web.archive.org/web/20030808023211/http://www.linguasport.com/futbol/nacional/copa/Copa46.htm Copa del Generalísimo 1946]}}</ref>
